assign.outcome:
**A page generator that needs no filesystem** - a seed draws a spec string, the spec builds a REAL page tree under `/framework/core/Page/generator/`: real urls, the real Router, the real `active-page` contract, core's columns. A top tab on [core/Page](/framework/core/Page/).

![](shot.png)

**The mechanism is data, not machinery.** `children:` already takes nested plain objects and `Page.add()` builds a real `Page` per entry, recursing. `ext/demo`'s `demo.tree()` was the obvious reuse and the wrong one - `DemoApp` plays Router, hijacks clicks and never changes the url. A generated page overrides exactly two methods: `column()` (its picture) and `link()` (the same url, carrying the seed).

**The words.** Blocks `tabs vtabs rail wall grid flush list prose crumbs`; widths `small large full` (core's own, declared as `width:` and stamped `.page-column-<width>`). A line is a page, indentation is nesting - space's DSL one level up, minus the `> part` half a page has no use for.

![](words.png)

**The law, proven on the page.** Every repaint runs `gen(seed)` a second time and compares: seed 7 = 14 pages / 171 chars, identical. Six seeds bit-identical in node (0, 1, 7, 42, 1234, 999999). Headless at 1920: three seeds rolled, two levels navigated, the deep url reloaded to an identical spec string AND an identical tree - `page column page--flush active-ancestor | page column page--tabs active-page`. Zero console errors.

[readme](/framework/core/Page/generator/readme/) . [doc/decisions.md](/framework/core/Page/generator/doc/decisions.md)
- Files: `gen.js` (seed to text) . `tree.js` (text to page configs) . `page.js` (controls) . `generator.css` (one picture per word). One line touched outside: `children:` in core/Page/page.js.

**Seam with S1:** core columns landed mid-build with a better API than design.md described - `page.columns()` is the host opt-in and the width words are `.page-column-small/large/full` from a page's `width:` field, not bare `.small/.large/.full`. This module was rewritten onto it and now restates NONE of the arrangement; a scoped copy written first was deleted (two sets at one specificity are decided by stylesheet order, and the copy silently lost a `min-width`).

**Left, deliberately:** the permutation wall (wave B), a typed spec (the parser already accepts one - only the textarea is missing), a chaos dial, and any rule about which block words work well together.
